# Amir Beck

> Senior product design engineer in San Francisco who both designs and ships fintech products. At Lumanu he leads the design of a B2B2C payments platform and personally builds it in React, Next.js, and TypeScript. He bridges Figma to production code on a design system that compounds.

## Facts

- Name: Amir Beck
- Role: Senior Product Design Engineer at Lumanu (February 2023 to present)
- Titles: product design engineer, design engineer, product designer
- Location: San Francisco, CA
- Focus: fintech and payments product design, design systems, interaction design, design to code, AI assisted prototyping
- Stack: React, TypeScript, Next.js, HTML/CSS, Figma, design tokens, Code Connect, Figma MCP
- Education: UC Davis, B.A. Digital Media and B.A. Economics

## Selected work

- Lumanu (2023 to now): leads design of a B2B2C payments platform. Personally coded ~90% of the app UI redesign. Pivoted company strategy from influencer marketing to payments. Work spans a role aware buyer dashboard, a tax engine for global tax compliance, vendor onboarding and compliance, reporting, and the design system to code alignment.
- SkySlope (2020 to 2022): improved UX across DigiSign, Forms, and Breeze. Led Breeze from concept through launch. Cut digital signing mistakes by ~50%. Made paperwork delegation easier for whole teams. Drove a 15% increase in cross product usage, opening new customer pipelines.
- Granate (2022 to 2023): led product design for a grief support app at an early stage startup. ~25% drop in onboarding drop off, ~30% increase in weekly engagement, and a component system that set the development team up for quick feature delivery.
- EasyPeady (2021): designed and launched a standalone real estate form app in under a quarter. Generated a pipeline of new customers and later became the groundwork for SkySlope Breeze.

## Playground

Live UI experiments at https://amirbeck.com/playground, rebuilt in React so they run in the browser rather than as screenshots.

- Linking withdrawal methods: the country and currency pair decides which payment rails are available. A US payout runs on ACH or an instant debit card. Everywhere else it is a local bank transfer where supported, and a SWIFT wire where not. Live mid market FX conversion.
- Permissions: granular workspace permissioning with permission groups, for enterprise buyers with stricter compliance requirements.
